'''November 2001 Brooklyn Center tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Outpost 2000, Brooklyn Center on 24 November 2001. [[Jim Li]] won it. It is known from Garrett Larson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3127">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-30-outpost-deadbody-style-11-24-01d3127/ outpost-deadbody-style-11-24-01], DeckTech (garrett "deadbody" larson, 30 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-30-outpost-deadbody-style-11-24-01d3127/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 November 2001
* '''Site:''' Outpost 2000, Brooklyn Center
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Jim Li]]
